title: Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
description: The cinematic action-adventure that forced Lara Croft to grow from an inexperienced young woman into a hardened survivor has been re-built for next-gen consoles, featuring an obsessively detailed Lara and a stunningly lifelike world. Lara must endure high-octane combat, customize her weapons and gear, and overcome grueling environments to survive her first adventure and uncover the island’s deadly secret.
descriptionEn: The cinematic action-adventure that forced Lara Croft to grow from an inexperienced young woman into a hardened survivor has been re-built for next-gen consoles, featuring an obsessively detailed Lara and a stunningly lifelike world. Lara must endure high-octane combat, customize her weapons and gear, and overcome grueling environments to survive her first adventure and uncover the island’s deadly secret.

description_short: مغامرة سينمائية تروي نشأة Lara Croft، مع استكشاف وقتال وطور جماعي عبر الإنترنت.
description_ar: رحلة نشأة Lara Croft من شابة قليلة الخبرة إلى ناجية صلبة على جزيرة خطرة. تجمع اللعبة بين الاستكشاف والتسلق والقتال وتطوير الأسلحة، ويضم إصدار Nintendo طور القصة واللعب الجماعي عبر الإنترنت حتى ثمانية لاعبين.
